description.value: Helen's Grill is a classic old-school diner on Main Street in Vancouver, a well-travelled urban cycling corridor. The single-storey spot serves diner staples and has been a neighbourhood fixture long enough to cultivate a loyal local following. For a touring cyclist rolling through South Vancouver, it offers a sit-down meal in an unpretentious, no-fuss setting.
